claims.evidence: Witness report shows an exposed engine assembly with hoses/wiring/components, but no readable make/model/variant markings and no proof of “2.0” or “Sensor” designation.
No vehicle-compatibility markings or part-number/engine-code readable in the witness report.
No engine code/part number or fitment documentation shown in the witness report.
No import documents, VIN/engine code plate, or Belgium sourcing evidence visible in the witness report.
Witness report only describes visible components in an exposed engine bay; it does not show a running test, sound recording, or compression/leak test results.
No odometer/mileage reading or service history is shown in the witness report.
No evidence of tamper seals, gasket condition, or teardown indicators is provided in the witness report.

risks.risk: Engine variant/engine code may not actually be 2.0 (or may be a different Volkswagen 2.0 family), leading to wrong fitment and unusable purchase.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code/part number plate (often on the engine block/head) and/or the full label with readable characters, plus a photo of the ECU/engine ID if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used Volkswagen engine assembly (worst-case fitment uncertainty).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” may be false; the engine could have internal wear not visible externally.
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine running (cold start if possible) showing stable idle and no knocking, plus a compression test sheet or scan tool live data.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Missing/damaged critical components (starter, ECU, sensors, wiring harness, sensors, timing-related parts) may not be visible in the single exposed photo.
risks.proof: A complete walk-around video showing all external components and connectors, including ECU, starter, alternator, crank/cam sensors, and any harness/relays; close-ups of any missing mounts/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: parts may be missing).

risks.risk: Leaks/overheating history (oil/coolant leaks, warped head, coolant passages) can’t be confirmed from the exposed assembly photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of gasket lines, oil pan area, coolant hoses/ports, and any staining; plus a leak test or cooling system pressure test result.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential leak/overheat risk (worst-case: may require reseal).

risks.risk: Compatibility claims for Passat 2.0 and Sharan may be wrong due to different years/transmissions/emissions setups.
risks.proof: Photos of the engine code plus the transmission code/gearbox type, and a fitment cross-reference (or the exact vehicle year/engine code it came from).
risks.if_unproven: Price as uncertain fitment across models (worst-case: buyer may need additional parts).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine code/part number plate with readable text (engine block/head).
Send a video of the engine running (start + idle) and/or a compression test result sheet.
Send photos showing ECU, starter, all sensors/connectors, and the full wiring harness (front-to-back, top-to-bottom).
Send close-ups of gasket areas and any signs of oil/coolant leakage, plus any service/repair records.
Confirm the exact vehicle year and engine code it came from (Passat/Sharan year + engine code), and show the gearbox/transmission type.
response.reason: The witness confirms an exposed used engine assembly, but there is no readable engine code/variant and no evidence of running/testing. Without proof of the exact 2.0 variant and working condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
